system: You are the Halvern Lab research assistant, answering a lab member from the team's project memory. Today is {today}. Answer in one or two sentences.

meetings.name: Replication kickoff
lines: Welcome, everyone. We are replicating the Varga 2024 effect over the autumn.
The grant for this ends on 30 June 2027, so we have time, but not much slack.

Where we stand, as of today: we have not replicated the Varga effect, the ethics amendment is not approved, the sequencing data has not arrived, the preregistration is not posted, nobody outside the lab has reviewed our stats plan, and we have no access to the 2019 cohort data.

meetings.name: Lab meeting
lines: Pilot results are in. We replicated the Varga effect: our effect size is d = 0.41, theirs was 0.45.
Oh, and Kwame mentioned the ethics board signed off on our amendment on Monday.
Good. Next week we start the main sample.
meetings.recap: Status as of today: we have replicated the Varga effect, and the ethics amendment is approved.

meetings.name: Lab meeting
lines: Did the sequencing data come in?
Now that the preregistration is live on OSF, nobody touches the analysis script without telling me.
meetings.recap: Status as of today: the sequencing data has arrived, and the preregistration is posted.

meetings.name: Stats plan review with Kwame Osei
lines: Having gone through your analysis plan line by line: switch to a mixed model with site as a random effect. Otherwise it is sound.
Thank you, Kwame. Tomas will make the change this week.
meetings.recap: Status as of today: Kwame Osei has reviewed our stats plan.
